# Agent Relay

> A local supervisor for Claude Code and Codex conversations.

Canonical website: https://ra1nm4ker.github.io/agent-relay/

Handbook examples are verified against stable v0.5.2. Read the handoff guide for continuity limits and the security model for ownership and authentication boundaries.

## Public pages

- [Product overview](https://ra1nm4ker.github.io/agent-relay/index.md): What Relay does, installation, and common questions.
- [Get started](https://ra1nm4ker.github.io/agent-relay/docs/getting-started.md): Install Relay, set up profiles, and start your first managed conversation.
- [Everyday workflows](https://ra1nm4ker.github.io/agent-relay/docs/workflows.md): Start, resume, switch, and adopt coding-agent conversations.
- [Command reference](https://ra1nm4ker.github.io/agent-relay/docs/commands.md): Find Agent Relay commands, options, and copyable examples.
- [Profiles & accounts](https://ra1nm4ker.github.io/agent-relay/docs/profiles.md): Manage isolated accounts and choose your fallback order.
- [Handoffs & capabilities](https://ra1nm4ker.github.io/agent-relay/docs/handoffs.md): Understand automatic handoff, session continuity, and current limits.
- [Inside your agent](https://ra1nm4ker.github.io/agent-relay/docs/integrations.md): Use Relay inside Claude Code, Codex, and optional Herdr sessions.
- [Troubleshooting](https://ra1nm4ker.github.io/agent-relay/docs/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose readiness, unavailable profiles, and interrupted handoffs.
- [Advanced use](https://ra1nm4ker.github.io/agent-relay/docs/advanced.md): Inspect transactions, script Relay, and work with development builds.

## Source and releases

- [Source repository](https://github.com/RA1NM4KER/agent-relay): Code, license, and project history.
- [Stable handbook source](https://github.com/RA1NM4KER/agent-relay/tree/v0.5.2): Version used to verify documentation examples.
- [Releases](https://github.com/RA1NM4KER/agent-relay/releases): Release notes and downloads.
